en: 2 Corinthians 5
ja: コリント人への第二の手紙 5

p.src: 1  For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

ja: まいが私たちにはあります。
en: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
u.src: 1  For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

p.src: 2  For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

ja: たちはこの幕屋にあってうめき、
en: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
u.src: 2  For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

p.src: 3  if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

ja: のままでいることはないからです。
en: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
u.src: 3  if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

p.src: 4  For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

ja: ぎたいのではなく、上から
せられたいのです。こうして、
en: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
u.src: 4  For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

p.src: 5  Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

ja: たちを造ってくださった
en: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
u.src: 5  Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

p.src: 6  Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

ja: を抱いています。そして、この
en: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
u.src: 6  Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

p.src: 7  for we walk by faith, not by sight.

ja: えるものによってではなく、
en: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
u.src: 7  for we walk by faith, not by sight.

p.src: 8  We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

en: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
u.src: 8  We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

p.src: 9  Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

ja: ばれることを私たちの目標としています。
en: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
u.src: 9  Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

p.src: 10  For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

ja: さなければなりません。それぞれが、良いことであれ悪いことであれ、
en: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
u.src: 10  For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

zh: 勸人與上帝和好的職分

p.src: 11  Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

ja: らかです。また、あなたがたの
らかになっていることを
en: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
u.src: 11  Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

p.src: 12  For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

ja: び自分たちをあなたがたに
しているのではありません。内面ではなく
えられるよう、私たちのことを誇る機会をあなたがたに与えているのです。
en: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
u.src: 12  For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

p.src: 13  For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

ja: でいるなら、それはあなたがたのためです。
en: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
u.src: 13  For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

p.src: 14  For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

ja: たちを駆り立てています。
たちはこう考えるからです。
なれたのだから、すべての
en: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.
u.src: 14  For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

p.src: 15  He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

ja: きるようになるためです。
en: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
u.src: 15  He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

p.src: 16  Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

ja: 間的な基準では見ません。たとえかつてキリストをそのように
en: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
u.src: 16  Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

p.src: 17  Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

ja: ですから、だれでもキリストのうちにいるなら、その
en: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
u.src: 17  Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

ja: 5:17 「見よ」は、ギリシャ語の「ἰδοὺ」に由来し、目を向ける、注意する、観察する、見る、またはじっと見つめるという意味である。しばしば間投詞として用いられる。
en: 5:17 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 18  But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

ja: はイエス・キリストを通して
たちに与えてくださいました。
en: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
u.src: 18  But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

p.src: 19  namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

ja: たちに託されたのです。
en: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
u.src: 19  namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

p.src: 20  We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

ja: して呼びかけておられるのです。キリストに
en: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
u.src: 20  We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

p.src: 21  For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

en: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
u.src: 21  For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
